caveats: Exploratory validation reuse, not independent evidence or threshold selection.
139 underlying groups and 417 correlated execution variants per policy; no new independent dataset.
Different targets and thresholds produce different trade/abstention paths; action-dependent execution noise limits pairing.
Synthetic, hypothetical and economically unverified; zero final losses in the strict completion gate is not a guarantee.
interpretation: Completion 0.50/full scored 1.015012 versus direct unmatched-risk 0.10/full 0.838531 and completion 0.90/full 0.701778 on the declared downside objective. Direct risk had higher mean P&L than both completion gates, but larger tail loss. Better unmatched-label Brier than inverse completion did not establish policy dominance.
next_experiment: Investigate paired loss cases and residual exposure severity; any new policy-selection experiment requires a frozen plan and fresh final groups. Existing selected risk gate and final tests remain unchanged.
title: Paired validation policies reverse the simple prediction-score ordering
